_format: Readable artifacts: a shiny thing in the world that opens a text to read when tapped.
id: unique, never changed once shipped (it remembers what has been read).
title: shown at the top of the page.
pages: one string per page; a blank line inside a string starts a new paragraph.
look: 'tablet' (an upright stone tablet), 'scroll' (a scroll resting on a stone) or 'stone' (a flat inscribed stone).
place: where it lies. Either { near: '<a name from the map>', dist: metres, bearing: radians clockwise from north } or { x, z } in world metres. Water is avoided by itself.
audio (optional): a recording to play while it is read, e.g. 'audio/readings/<id>.mp3'.
sample (optional): true keeps it out of the game; it shows only in dev mode (?dev=1) and still frames.
